output.hook: Clipping your podcast by hand is killing your week.

scenes.visual: Screen recording: a timeline in a video editor with a 60-minute podcast episode loaded — hundreds of cuts, manual markers everywhere
scenes.voiceover: Clipping your podcast by hand is killing your week.

scenes.visual: Screen recording: podclip dashboard — user pastes an episode URL or uploads an audio file, hits 'Generate Clips'
scenes.voiceover: podclip ingests your episode and finds the moments worth sharing — not random 60-second windows, actual narrative hooks.

scenes.visual: Screen recording: progress bar moving fast — a timer overlay showing roughly 90 seconds elapsing — then a grid of 4-6 captioned vertical clips appearing
scenes.voiceover: Its model was trained on 40,000 manually rated clips. A 60-minute episode renders into a full clip set in about 90 seconds.

scenes.visual: Side-by-side: two vertical clips playing — one with bold, on-brand captions matching a show's color palette; another with a different show's style — both look polished, no editor needed
scenes.voiceover: Every clip comes out captioned and vertically framed — with your show's style baked in. Ready for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, and X.

scenes.visual: podclip showcase page scrolling — clips from different shows, all captioned, all vertical
scenes.voiceover: 120 shows are already generating clips every week. Start free — three clips a month, no credit card.
Your best 40 seconds, found for you.

output.cta: Try podclip free at {APP_URL} — three clips a month, no credit card needed.
production_notes: Record a screen capture of the podclip dashboard: uploading or pasting a real episode URL and clicking Generate Clips.
Capture the render progress bar in real time — show the actual ~90-second countdown so the speed claim is visually verifiable.
Record the clip results grid appearing after render: show at least 4 captioned vertical clips with visible captions and framing.
Record two different shows' clips side by side to demonstrate per-show caption style differentiation — use real clips from the showcase page if available.
Capture a scroll of the podclip showcase page showing variety of shows and clip styles.
Capture the podclip homepage with the URL clearly visible for the final frame.
Do NOT use stock footage or mockups — all visuals must be real app screens to maintain credibility.
Keep the voiceover delivery punchy and fast-paced to match the energetic brand voice — no slow reads.
warnings: The '120 shows generate clips weekly' proof point is used as stated in the profile — do not inflate or round up this number in production.
The model training claim (40,000 manually rated clips) is not externally documented per the profile's own confidence notes — avoid framing it as a third-party verified benchmark.
The 90-second render time is an average for a 60-minute episode — add a brief disclaimer in description copy if platform policies require accuracy disclosures.
No direct TikTok publishing exists yet — do not imply one-click publishing to TikTok in visuals; show download/export flow instead.
